correctness.rationale: Clipping is inactive jointly in state and parameter near the interior onset point. The cyclic Fourier polynomial multiplication gives the exact recurrence; the real multiplier is strictly inside the unit circle up to and across onset locally, and the complex pair has d|λ|/dr=1 at r_c. The unit eigenvalue is in the open upper half-plane with the only strong resonances at s=1/3 and s=1. In the stated Fourier normalization, the quadratic graph coefficient is −(s+3); elimination of the nonresonant conjugate-square term gives Re(conj(λ_c)C)=−(s+3)^3/(s+1)^2, verified symbolically from an independently constructed cyclic Fourier polynomial. The smooth local Neimark–Sacker theorem and transverse contraction give the attracting curve. To make the uniform leading estimate explicit, writing L=−Re(conj(λ_c)C)>0, sandwich the radial map on the shrinking curve by R↦R[1+(1±η)ε−(L∓η)R²]; these envelopes are increasing locally. Invariance then bounds the minimum radius below by the positive fixed radius of the lower envelope and the maximum above by that of the upper envelope, in the sense min R ≥ sqrt((1−η)ε/(L+η)) and max R ≤ sqrt((1+η)ε/(L−η)). Let η tend to zero and use the near-identity coordinate change and the smooth parameter-dependent quadratic center graph to obtain both uniform profiles.
residual_risks: Applies for each fixed nonresonant interaction near onset. The symbolic replay checks local algebra, not existence on its own. No conclusion about the excluded resonances, global attraction, or the rotation number at every nearby parameter.
